dedupe_keys.name: dataset on physics based indicators for optimizing phase change material effectiveness in building design

description: Facundo Bre and colleagues publish results and EnergyPlus models developed to investigate indicators of phase-change material effectiveness at whole-building level. The native description identifies indicator investigation and validation as the purpose. Six file descriptors list EnergyPlus models, weather files and four CSV result files labelled 3A, 4A, 5A and 6A. These components form one building-performance simulation dataset. Zenodo provides free access under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is a simulated prototype with unspecified location. The metadata does not state the full simulation period, variable units or result-table structure. Climate-zone labels do not establish a measured geographical survey. Related publications by the same authors discuss these indicators, but their claims are not independently verified here. No model, weather file or result value was downloaded, and the dataset does not by itself establish validation accuracy.
